abstract: Sinonasalteratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS) is a highly malignant and aggressive neoplasm which can quickly damage the local soft tissue, bone tissue, and invade orbital and intracranial tissues. It also can result in local lymph node and distant organ metastasis. The data from 2 cases of SNTCS from the First Affiliated Hospital of Bengbu Medical College (China), treated with radiotherapy and chemotherapy followed by cranio-facial resection, were analyzed since 2016. The main symptoms of the two patients were of the nasal cavity with nasal congestion and runny nose. There was no recurrence after surgery. Microscopic examination showed that the composition of tumor tissue was very complex, as different degrees of differentiation of the origin of the organization could be seen in the tumor tissue. It was mixed with teratoma and cancer sarcoma components and undifferentiated/primitive tumor cells could also be seen in local tumor stroma. SNTCS is a very rare complex tissue composition of malignant tumors, because of its complex pathological morphology and high possibility of misdiagnosis. Pathological features and immunohistochemical markers can contribute to the diagnosis and differential diagnosis of the disease.
abstract_ja: 副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫(SNTCS)は、悪性度が高く攻撃性の強い腫瘍であり、局所の軟部組織や骨組織を急速に破壊し、眼窩内や頭蓋内の組織に浸潤しうる。また、局所リンパ節転移や遠隔臓器転移を引き起こすこともある。2016年以降に中国の蚌埠医学院附属第一病院で、放射線療法と化学療法の後に頭蓋顔面切除を施行された2例のSNTCSのデータを解析した。2名の患者の主な症状は鼻腔症状であり、鼻閉と鼻汁であった。術後に再発は認められなかった。顕微鏡検査では、腫瘍組織の構成が非常に複雑で、腫瘍組織内に異なる程度に分化した起源組織が認められた。奇形腫と癌肉腫の成分が混在し、局所の腫瘍間質には未分化/原始的な腫瘍細胞も認められた。SNTCSは非常に稀な複合組織構成の悪性腫瘍であり、病理形態が複雑で誤診の可能性が高い。病理学的特徴と免疫組織化学マーカーは、本疾患の診断と鑑別診断に役立つ。
